questions: cq.attachment: Do the retained markers faithfully link both XML and PDF to footnote 3? The combined packet supports that attachment but supplies no extension to the web alternative.
cq.boundary: Does implementation in footnote 2 mean the 9:00am operational launch or the start of the general effective date? Both interpretations remain defeasible.
cq.timezone: Which timezone governs the transition times and event timestamps? The retained text does not specify one.

cq.actor_event: What evidence establishes the entity's membership in the source-defined licensed-firm categories and the event's status as an actual STR submission? Classification is an assessment, not a narrower category of firms.

cq.certificate: What operational relationship with the Hongkong Post e-Cert satisfies footnote 3, and what event evidence establishes it? Signing, attachment, authentication, holder identity, authorization and validity mechanics remain unspecified.

cq.abstract_model: Is the required deliverable a conditional logical specification or a self-contained operational decision procedure? An explicitly unresolved external certificate predicate can serve the former but does not establish the latter.
cq.pdf: Which PDF form is prescribed, was it completed, and was that completed form uploaded in this same event? A combined predicate needs evidence for all three components.

cq.attempt: For node.c8bd87cfd64bba8762d9b3a0, how should attempted filings be classified? Its stated domain includes attempts, while the supporting actual-submission control does not establish their treatment.

cq.contact: What establishes urgency, what listed direct contact occurred, and what subsequent steps complete filing? The contact instruction alone establishes neither filing completion nor follow-up requirements.

cq.xml: Which schema and version apply, what establishes conformity, and how is prompt liaison assessed? Arranging a test is required; successful testing as a prerequisite to filing is not established by this packet.

cq.control_scope: Is schema conformity deliberately included in the selected control or tracked separately? The broader and narrower controls can both preserve the source, but their outputs are not interchangeable.

Formal defect requiring repair: node.583a0a4d40d9fa690cc9a445 references is_xml_submission without declaring it in its facts array. Node.f75383097facdc52b0ac66f7 declares that fact. This input-level observation concerns expression closure, not the truth of the substantive reading; source quotations do not independently prove the syntactic defect.
cq.remedy: What guidance establishes resubmission procedure, timing and discharge? No deadline or discharge test is supplied, and the promise of guidance does not expressly suspend the duty.
cq.history: Which events concern the same STR, and is the history complete enough to support a negative report-level trigger? A negative selected event cannot rule out another qualifying submission.
cq.actor_link: Is each qualifying historical submission attributable to the assessed licensed firm? The aggregate in node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3 should preserve this relationship explicitly.

For node.8caddb7a4c29338c1d340db1, does original identify the selected triggering event rather than necessarily the earliest submission? Footnote 2 does not restrict its trigger to the earliest event.

cq.unknowns: What partial-information semantics govern the formulas? Missing evidence must not become false. In node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb, not established must not authorize that conversion; unknown scope supplies no compliance verdict.
cq.external_material: Do the absent technical specifications or resubmission guidance alter an operational condition or procedure? Their contents and any additional exceptions must remain unresolved.

Source reconciliation: footnotes 2 and 3, actor definitions and launch context are present in the combined packet despite some extraction-level missing-context statements. Certificate mechanics, schema contents and resubmission guidance remain absent.

The 12-argument limit requires consolidating overlapping readings. Retained argument and inference IDs are unchanged. Event-level and report-history trigger readings survive as complementary assessments under arg.separate_remedy; conditional certificate controls survive subject to arg.conditional_supplied_certificate. No actual compliance, discharge or lateness verdict is assigned.
No relevant sourced case is supplied; cases and case_queries are therefore empty. STRICT would denote only a claimed deductive step, not certification of source truth.
